reviews.author: Toni Strickland
reviews.text: Exceptional service! Always great prices, amazing repairs, and such great people! Will always be a customer of moores!!

reviews.author: Bernice Slade
reviews.text: Mr. Moore is a stand up guy. I've had very satisfactory experiences with his business. He doesn't do inspections anymore, but he referred me to another business for this need and his referral was spot on. Shout out to Mr. Moore!

reviews.author: Angela Curry
reviews.text: Mr.Moore and his outstanding team of mechanics are the best in the business. From prompt and flexible appointments, to awesome customer service, friendly staff and excellence in auto mechanic service. Their knowledge and skills are tops in their field, from Mr. Moore himself, to the guys turning the wrenches. I wouldn’t entrust my vehicle’s needs to ANYONE ELSE.

reviews.author: Tony “TJ”
reviews.text: Never having serviced a car in Newport News I called a few places before Moore's and everyone was backed up. And they were all pretty short with me. When I called Moore's they were booked up for a week too. But the owner took time to talk me through my car's symptoms. And he recommended someone he trusted who might be able to help me quicker than they could. Very impressed.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: The most honest auto repair shop. Steve is always nice, helpful and very personable . I never doubt any of my repairs . If Steve says I need something done never questioned him . His father was a fair and righteous man . Just a great place to have your car worked on

reviews.author: Patricia
reviews.text: Moores have done repairs on different vehicles in my household over the years. Always excellent customer service, price, and repair work that last.

reviews.author: Eileen Kyker
reviews.text: I have been a satisfied customer of Moores Auto Repair for several years and wouldn’t want anyone else working on my 2009 Ford Escape. Excellent work, great customer service and reasonable prices. Could not be happier!

reviews.author: Graham Tolley
reviews.text: I wish I could give Moore's more than 5 stars. They are family owned and have been in business for decades. I can always trust Steve and his crew to give me an honest evaluation and a fair price plus they've always delivered their work on time. One day I will retire and move from here and Moore's will probably be the only place I miss!

reviews.author: Jessica C.
reviews.text: I was referred here by a friend and I was not disappointed. Mr. Moore was punctual and extremely friendly despite me mixing up my appointment day and time. I will continue to bring my car here in the future! Rick (I believe that was his name) was the gentleman that performed my state inspection and he was also very friendly.

reviews.author: Wanda Abbott
reviews.text: Have always been treated fairly. They never try to take advantage of me because I am a woman. So happy my neighbors recommended him. This is my third time using him and I am still impressed. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tracy Evans
reviews.text: Always honest and they do a great job with your car. It's hard to find quality and trustworthy together They have both.

reviews.author: Noah Eskew
reviews.text: I have no idea how Moore's Auto is able to do great work so quickly! I'm amazed by the quick turnaround time on every repair, and my friends/family have noticed this for decades. If you need it done well and done fast, Moore's is the place.

reviews.author: Cliff Coates
reviews.text: Good people! They take appointments for car inspections, which is great for scheduling. If I ever need more than an inspection, I will definitely consider coming back here.

reviews.author: Tam Washington
reviews.text: Mr. Steve is an honest guy. He and the team does great work at great prices. I trust this ship and have been a customer for about 15 years. Thank you!

reviews.author: KMB
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful! Moore's Auto Repair has been my go-to spot for every auto related event for the past 6 years. I refer everyone I know to them. These gentlemen are professional, knowledgeable, and caring. They are honest and fair I'm pricing, work, and detail. I cannot thank Steve enough for the work he has done for me and my family. A++!!!

reviews.author: Brittany Harris
reviews.text: Very nice went in for an ac service. My ac is ice cold i had a leak the went ahead and fixed it for me. Price was more than reasonable. Straightforward honest people ..If only all mechanics were like the ones you'd find at Moore's.

reviews.author: Steven James
reviews.text: My only mechanic since I moved back from California 13 years ago. I trust them implicitly and never doubt their integrity, honesty or ability! Look no further! My vehicle may let me down from time to time but Moore’s Auto Repair never does.

reviews.author: Eric Silverman
reviews.text: We don't let other mechanics touch our cars if we can help it. Moore's is honest and competent. They won't sell you things you don't need. They have saved our car from another mechanic's incompetence at least once. Highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Paula Van Rassel
reviews.text: After being taken advantage of at other car places, this place is refreshing. They do a good job, know what they are doing, and don't overcharge me. Lots of people know this...so you pretty much need an appointment, but you get in and get done quick.

reviews.author: Shannon Combs
reviews.text: I am so glad I found them on google. I was able to make a state inspection appointment, unlike any where else I contacted. I arrived on time and services were completed right away and they had me in and out. Excellent Service, I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ted Warren
reviews.text: My whole family takes our cars to Steve! His mechanics are top notch! There was not been a time where we have been overcharged or felt forced into unnecessary repairs! Easily a top notch mechanic place!

reviews.author: Kim Craig
reviews.text: Made appointment for an inspection polite professional. Also asked to get my fluids checked in my hoses and belts they did that with no problem or cost. I am very happy with them and I will be going back for any other needs I have

reviews.author: Grant Reynolds
reviews.text: Great place! They do incredible work at a great price. They worked with me when a part didn't come in at the right time to get me my vehicle as quickly as possible. Love it!

reviews.author: Erik Lathrop
reviews.text: Moore’s is always our go to auto repair shop. Always friendly and helpful. Great work and they never hesitate to let you know if they can’t do the repairs and are quick to recommend a place that can.

reviews.author: Sonja Williams (Sunray4life)
reviews.text: Always a pleasure. One of the few places I feel taken serious as a woman. If I ask about repairs, they even show me the replaced parts. Fair prices . Usually busy so call ahead to make an appointment.

reviews.author: Connie Thompson
reviews.text: I have taken my cars to Moores Auto Repair for over 30 years. They are always very busy so if you need inspection or oil change call ahead and schedule appointment.

reviews.author: Cheryl Rolon
reviews.text: HONEST AND REASONABLE! If you need any repairs or maintenance on your car this is the place to go. We have been going to Mr. Moore for years and will continue to bring all our vehicles here as long as he is in business.

reviews.author: Ed Saunders
reviews.text: I have been dealing here 27 1/2 years ... Always great service above and beyond the call ... Begining with Charlie Moore and now with his Son Steve ... These are Christian People who will take care of your needs.

reviews.author: Monteir Pulley
reviews.text: These folks provide good customer service and very good work at honest pricing. They simply do good business.

reviews.author: Beautiful Mistress THEE
reviews.text: Mr Moore is always friendly and ready to work. Place is small but clean. Good mechanic and reasonable prices. Better than dealership.

reviews.author: Preston Lane
reviews.text: Awesome mechanics providing the work you need. Honest experienced management. No tricks no gimmicks. Very busy, but still make and meet appointments for inspection.

reviews.author: Mason Emblidge
reviews.text: Steve and his mechanics are great. Easily a 5 star rating for his honesty alone. Very personable and always stays in touch with us.

reviews.author: Jim Crutchfield
reviews.text: An honest auto mechanic is a pearl of great price. The folks at Moore's are honest and capable. I always go there first.

reviews.author: Glenn Sheene
reviews.text: My Dad always said if you find a good mechanic take him a Christmas gift and get them a card for there birthday. This is one of those places maybe not the cheapest but always quality work.

reviews.author: Deanna Banana
reviews.text: Great place. They never try to trick you into an uneccesary repair just to get you to spend money. They get you in and out. Prices are reasonable.

reviews.author: Everett Morton
reviews.text: one of the last of the good old days with good honest, friendly people. they have my complete trust when it comes to my cars

reviews.author: Ann Leggat
reviews.text: Took my car in for a scheduled inspection. Everyone was pleasant and they had the job finished in 30 minutes.

reviews.author: Jonathan Reedy
reviews.text: Profesional, fair, and honest shop. Small town shop, fair pricing, always treat me with respect and promptness.

reviews.author: Sunny Ruther
reviews.text: Reliable auto repair Company in Newport News Va. Work was completed ahead of schedule. Reasonable charge for repair.
